package.title: Vacation application forms: the assistant fills the three corporate RTF applications (vacation, transfer, unpaid) from a chat dialog and delivers the file as an attachment

specification.intent: Operator request of 2026-11-08: the assistant fills the three corporate vacation application RTF forms (Заявление о переносе отпуска.RTF, заявление на отпуск.RTF, заявление на отпуск свой счет.RTF from tasks/RAG-docs/) — collects the missing fields in a chat dialog, autofills the rest from the ingested 2026 schedule (фамилия from vacation_names, периоды and должность from vacation_periods — the operator confirmed должность IS the first xlsx column and the parser already stores it), renders the RTF deterministically and delivers the ready file as a chat attachment over the existing FileService→MessageCreate(file_id) path. Byte-level facts (feasibility probe + review r1, D-F-18): the originals are r7-office RTF whose entire text is \uNNNN* escapes — values render in the same profile, and the {\info} metadata group (carrying a third real name and a legal-DB vendor marker) is removed during derivation. Three operator clarifications: sanitized placeholder templates live in the repo with the real requisites (the header org/addressee values — never in git) supplied from environment config (D-F-1); должность autofills from the schedule, the earlier ask-once proposal is cancelled (D-F-2); vacation dates autofill from the schedule with confirmation and custom dates are typed in the dialog (D-F-3). Autonomy mandate «делай автономно» (D-F-0) authorizes the full run; the live smoke stays a deferred operator gate (EV-4) — final audit BLOCKED, the PR held, mirroring the parent run's D-3. Non-goals: the увольнение form (D-F-15), full-name expansion (D-F-7), LLM phrasing of wizard texts (D-F-6), any frontend change.

requirements.title: Sanitized RTF templates and the form registry
requirements.description: backend/app/vacations/templates/{vacation_application.rtf, vacation_transfer.rtf, unpaid_vacation.rtf} derived from the READ-ONLY originals in tasks/RAG-docs/. Encoding profile (byte-verified, D-F-18/F-R1-1): r7-office RTF ({\rtf1\ansi\ansicpg0}) where EVERY character — Cyrillic AND digits/dots/spaces/underscores — is a \uNNNN* escape (decimal \u + the '*' fallback byte; zero \'hh bytes). Derivation rules: (1) the real header requisites are searched as FULLY-ESCAPED runs and replaced with the ASCII tokens {{org_name}} / {{addressee}} (the transfer original carries the org name twice); (2) the {\info} metadata group is REMOVED entirely — its \author carries a third real name with a unit tag in two originals and a legal-DB vendor marker in the other (F-R1-2/D-F-10); (3) underscore blanks are consecutive \u95* runs possibly split by RTF format groups, mapped positionally to the token set of specification.md ({{position}}, {{full_name}}, {{today}}, {{year}}, {{start_date}}, {{days}}, {{days_word}}, {{old_start}}, {{old_days}}, {{old_days_word}}, {{new_start}}, {{new_days}}, {{new_days_word}}), the signature line keeping its подпись underscores; (4) the date slot cluster «\_\_.\_\_ 202\_\_ г.» collapses to «{{start_date}} {{year}} г.» with {{start_date}} = DD.MM (a full date duplicates the year — probe finding, F-R1-7) and {{today}} = DD.MM.YYYY, declared in FormSpec; (5) the «календарных дней» literals parameterize to {{days_word}} = the FULL agreed phrase from a forms-module helper calendar_days_word (1 «календарный день» / 2 «календарных дня» / 14 «календарных дней» — F-R1-3/D-F-9; the parent days_word stays untouched). backend/app/vacations/forms/registry.py: FormSpec(id, title, template_name, tokens, filename_title, value formats) for the three forms + load_template() reading the package dir via Path(__file__). Tests: tests/unit/vacations/test_forms_registry.py — template tokens == registry tokens per form; the structural pin that no template contains {\info}; fictional-fixture privacy pins (fixture org «ООО «Альфа-Тех»», addressee «Смирнову А.А.» — the REAL marker list lives only in the controller's local work/ evidence, D-F-10/D-F-16). EV-3 (controller, local, artifacts in work/ only) opens every REAL-filled form in Word and cross-checks the extracted text.
requirements.source: operator decision D-F-1 (repo templates, env requisites) + real-file research (Word COM text extraction of the three originals, 2026-11-08)

requirements.title: Deterministic RTF renderer
requirements.description: backend/app/vacations/forms/rtf.py — escape_rtf_text(value): literal safe ASCII passthrough (excluding backslash/braces, which are escaped), EVERYTHING else (Cyrillic, «», —, digits in values stay literal only if ASCII-safe) → \uNNNN* decimal escapes with the '*' fallback byte — the SAME profile as the originals, so value interpretation never depends on the reader's code page (D-F-18/F-R1-1); code points above 32767 (never occurs for Russian) use the RTF signed-word surrogate policy with a '?' fallback. fill(rtf_bytes, mapping) -> bytes: byte-level replacement of {{token}} strings, PRE-validation that the mapping keys equal the template's token set exactly (ValueError listing missing/extra), post-check that no '{{' remains; template_tokens(rtf_bytes) -> set[str]. Pure stdlib, no new dependencies; deterministic (same input — same output bytes). Tests: tests/unit/vacations/test_rtf.py (escape pins incl. «Абрикосов Т.П.» → \u1040*-style sequences, brace/backslash escaping, key-set mismatch errors, leftover-token error, byte-identical regeneration, and the FormSpec value formats: DD.MM period dates with the year in its own slot, DD.MM.YYYY today).
requirements.source: RTF byte-profile research (\uNNNN* escapes in the real files, byte-verified 2026-11-08) + D-F-6 determinism

requirements.title: Form intents classified above the vacation intents
requirements.description: backend/app/vacations/intent.py — classify() returns 'form_vacation' | 'form_transfer' | 'form_unpaid' checked BEFORE 'schedule'/'vacation'. Keyword matching is EXACT word forms at word boundaries — no prefix/stem matching (F-R1-4/D-F-19): the заявление keywords (заявление/заявления/заявление-derivatives listed explicitly) plus отпуск → form_vacation; перенос/перенеси + отпуск → form_transfer; unpaid triggers are CORROBORATED compound phrases only («свой счёт»/«свой счет»/«за свой счёт»/«без сохранения зарплаты»/«без сохранения заработной платы»/«без содержания» with vacation context) — a bare «счёт» and billing phrasings never trigger (F-R1-8/D-F-19); «нужен/хочу отпуск» without a заявление keyword stays vacation. Negatives: «заявление на увольнение» matches NO form kind (увольнение excludes, D-F-15); «Как оформить отпуск?» → vacation (the parent pin — token-exact matching keeps оформить-derivatives out unless a заявление keyword is present; F-R1-4). The existing kinds keep their exact behavior («когда мой отпуск по графику» → schedule, «хочу в отпуск» → vacation — parent regression pins). backend/app/vacations/skill.py — VacationSkill.handle explicitly skips form kinds (a form message must not trigger the dates offer). Tests: tests/unit/vacations/test_intent.py extended with the form pins including the увольнение/stem/billing negatives and the parent regressions.
requirements.source: D-F-12 routing decision + D-F-15 non-goal exclusion + parent classifier research (noun-boundary verb guard)

requirements.title: FormsSkill: three deterministic wizards over the shared dialog state
requirements.description: backend/app/vacations/forms/skill.py — VacationFormsSkill(session, files).handle(*, content, user_id) -> FormsOutcome(reply, passthrough_question, attachment: GeneratedForm(filename, content_type, body) | None) | None. Routing: a pending 'form:' state continues the matching wizard; a fresh form intent starts one and CLEARS any parent dialog state (D-F-12 pivot); a form intent of a DIFFERENT kind during an active wizard RESTARTS the wizard with the new kind and a cleared payload (F-R1-9/D-F-19); anything else → None (the parent VacationSkill and the normal path stay next). Pre-steps: requisites-config refusal (REQ-CONFIG2); surname step via the SHARED helper backend/app/vacations/surname_flow.py (D-F-13: the ask/validate/persist loop extracted from the parent skill — token-exact matching, ambiguity list, difflib hints, 2 attempts, cancel words without attempt burn, canonical name persisted on success; the parent skill switches to the helper with its observable behavior pinned by its existing tests). Wizards per specification.md: vacation (period confirm/choice/custom dates), transfer (old period from the schedule, new dates with days defaulting to the old), unpaid (dates always asked, days required); deterministic date parser (dd.mm.yyyy / dd.mm, year from the schedule snapshot; days 1..365; «с … на … дней» tolerated; two malformed attempts end politely); summary confirmation before generation; должность from VacationPerson.position with an in-wizard fallback question when the график row lacks it (D-F-2, no persistence); cancel words / TTL 600 s / unrelated-message reset mirror the parent semantics; states use a CLOSED step dictionary 'form:<kind>:<step>' (longest 'form:vacation:choose_period' = 27 chars; a unit pin walks every declared step and refuses > 32 — F-R1-5/D-F-11) + payload JSON in assistant_dialog_state. Generation: registry + rtf.fill with the form's token values (дата заявления = server today DD.MM.YYYY, period dates DD.MM with the year in its own slot, {{days_word}} from calendar_days_word — D-F-8/D-F-9/D-F-18). Tests: the 13 scenarios of AC-WIZARD.
requirements.source: operator flows D-F-2/D-F-3 + specification.md dialog specs + parent state machine pattern

requirements.title: Attachment delivery seam in the bot run
requirements.description: backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/bot.py (the ONLY api file in any write-set — narrow seam exception from the parent run's blanket ban, D-F-5; everything outside the declared writes still fails the ownership audit): the endpoint constructs FileService(db, get_object_storage(settings, request.app.state), settings) — the same composition as the files endpoint — and passes it into BotService as an optional files param (None default keeps every existing construction green). backend/app/services/bot.py: _execute calls VacationFormsSkill(self.session, self._files).handle(content, user_id=message.user_id) BEFORE the parent VacationSkill; a reply WITHOUT attachment posts exactly as today; a reply WITH attachment uploads via FileService.upload(chat_id=chat.id, owner_id=bot_user.id — the bot is an active member by add_member — original_name from GeneratedForm, content_type='application/rtf'), then MessageCreate(content=reply, file_id=file.id), run.attachment_file_id = file.id; files is None with an attachment → fail('form_storage_unavailable'); an upload exception → fail('form_storage_failed') (the durable retry regenerates and re-posts). The existing RAG attachment path, CAS/broadcast/streaming are untouched. Tests: FakeStorage seam in tests/integration/bot/test_vacation_forms_flow.py asserting the uploaded bytes (\uNNNN*-escaped values inside), the filename, message.file_id, run succeeded + attachment_file_id, and both failure kinds.
requirements.source: research (files.py active-member upload guard, MessageCreate.file_id contract, _is_library_file bot-attachment precedent, endpoint app.state composition) + D-F-5

criteria.title: Sanitized templates and registry proven by pytest
criteria.statement: The three RTF templates ship in backend/app/vacations/templates/ with the specification's token set; template_tokens == the registry's declared tokens per form; NO template contains an {\info} group (structural pin — the originals' author metadata carries a third real name and a vendor marker, F-R1-2); no real-requisite bytes anywhere in the repo — pinned by fictional-analogue tests plus the controller's local-marker grep of AC-PROCESS2; the tokens are pure ASCII inside text runs, the date cluster collapsed per D-F-18 (layout otherwise intact).

PASS = every test green EXCEPT exactly the 4 known POSIX-only ingestion failures (tests/unit/ingestion/test_converter.py, WinError 193, identical before and after, outside the write-set), zero new failures, zero deleted tests, full output before/after retained in evidence.

releaseImpact: Backend-only: a new deterministic forms core (templates + registry + renderer + two env requisites) inside backend/app/vacations, migration 016 adding one nullable column, a FormsSkill-first branch in BotService._execute with a FileService seam injected at the bot endpoint, and attachments posted through the existing message path. No WS protocol, store-shape or frontend changes; rollback = alembic downgrade of 016 + branch revert. The dev PR is held until the live smoke passes (D-F-0), stacked per D-F-4.
finalAuditGates: [AC-TEMPLATES|EV-1] sanitized templates + registry token equality + no-requisite pins — pytest
[AC-DATA|EV-1] migration 016 segment roundtrip + position exposure + payload store — pytest
[AC-REALFORMS|EV-3] all three REAL-filled forms open in Word with correct values (controller-local, artifacts in work/ only)
[AC-INTENT2|EV-2] form intents first, увольнение excluded, parent kinds pinned — pytest
[AC-WIZARD|EV-2] thirteen dialog scenarios incl. pivot, surname step, TTL, third-party, unset requisites
[AC-DELIVER|EV-2] FakeStorage attachment bytes/filename/message.file_id + both storage failure kinds
[AC-PROCESS2|EV-2] D-11 gate, ownership clean, no-requisite grep, progress_log, no-coauthor commits
[AC-LIVE2|EV-4] live smoke on the raised stack — final audit BLOCKED until the operator files EV-4; the PR merges only after (D-F-0)

securityGates.statement: The real org name and the addressee name never enter git: templates carry {{org_name}}/{{addressee}}, tests use fictional fixtures, real values live only in the operator env and local work/ evidence; a repo-wide grep plus tests pin it.
Forms are generated only for the user's own stored canonical schedule name; there is no third-party generation path; third-party phrasing routes to the own flow.

src/, app/ws, app/core, app/ingestion and app/bot are forbidden writes; the only api file written is api/v1/endpoints/bot.py (narrow seam, D-F-5); tasks/RAG-docs is read-only; durable bot-run semantics and transports stay untouched.

tierResolution.reason: multiple-executable-owners, architecture-risk and security-risk resolved by agent-lifecycle tier resolve

nonGoals: the увольнение application and any other HR form (D-F-15)
full-name expansion beyond the canonical schedule form (D-F-7)
PDF conversion, e-signature, filing/sending the document anywhere
template editing UI or runtime template loading from the data dir (templates are repo code, D-F-1)
vacation_names.position column (cancelled by the operator correction D-F-2)
